summary: The 2.6 upgrade converts controller users to platform users; controller admins become platform admins, others keep mapped permissions after a password reset. Hub and EDA component-level accounts need an admin password reset. SSO and LDAP migrate automatically except accounts using a trust store certificate.
questions: What happens to controller users when upgrading to AAP 2.6?
Do hub and EDA users need a password reset after upgrading?
Do LDAP and SSO users need migration for AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: User migration in the AAP 2.6 upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
- Controller accounts become platform accounts; controller admins become platform admins. Log in with your controller credentials.
- Component-level accounts (private automation hub, EDA) need a password reset by an admin before login.
- Authenticators migrate automatically; SSO and LDAP need no steps, except configs that use a certificate from the trust store.
